subject: [RFC PATCH v3 00/14] Introduce tiered memcg limits

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand
reviews.summary: Identified a potential issue with the tier-aware memory limits, suggesting that the current implementation may lead to incorrect reclaim decisions. Proposed an alternative approach using a separate page counter for each tier.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Expressed concerns about the complexity and overhead of implementing tier-aware memory limits, suggesting that a simpler approach may be more suitable. Asked for clarification on the benefits of this new feature.

2026-08-07.patch_summary: This patch series introduces tiered memory limits for the memory cgroup controller, allowing for proportional scaling and enforcement of memory limits across different tiers of memory. The patches modify various functions in the mm/memcontrol.c file to make them aware of the tiered limits, enabling fair distribution of memory among workloads on multi-host systems.
